description.en: Specifies whether the service is a trial service.
The region of the virtual Internet.

description.zh: 连接模式 (PrivateLink: PrivateLink, OverlayLink: 基于ANSM的overlayLink)
description.en: The connection mode. Valid values: \`PrivateLink\` and \`OverlayLink\`. \`OverlayLink\` is an overlay link that is based on Application-aware Network Service Mesh (ANSM).

description.zh: 服务id, 和isPoc 为true,一起用
description.en: The service ID. This parameter is used with the \`IsPoc\` parameter when \`IsPoc\` is set to \`true\`.

description.zh: 正/反向私网访问 (Forward: 正向访问, Reverse: 反向访问)
description.en: The direction of the internal-facing access. Valid values: \`Forward\` and \`Reverse\`.
The region where the service is deployed.

description.zh: 服务版本,和isPoc 为true,一起用
description.en: The service version. This parameter is used with the \`IsPoc\` parameter when \`IsPoc\` is set to \`true\`.
The zone where the service is deployed.
